FAIL-OPEN CONFIGURATION, checkable: rollout dial names the Org canary (E7-F018's shared blocker) + instance enableIsolatedWorkspaces true (the DEFAULT, workspace-resolution.ts:99-100) + a realized workspace (heartbeat.ts:3770/:3907) + at least one workspaceRuntime.services[] entry (workspace-runtime.ts:2593-2596) that is FRESHLY STARTED rather than reused (the reuse branch persists the ORIGINAL starter's run id, so a warm reuse does not trip it - the same !service.reused distinction heartbeat.ts:4561 already draws) + a task-scoped run (task-output-emitters.ts:92). The service need not work: the row is written at 'starting', before readiness, and the failure path re-persists the same externalId rather than removing it. A weaker form needs no dial at all - verify() only early-returns on a nonexistent run (e7-distributed-run-verifier.ts:341-352), so any ordinary heartbeat run that started a runtime service already prints capability: PROVEN today (with ok: FAIL, since clause 1 refuses a non-distributed run). NEW rather than an extension of E7-F015 because an authorization-shaped fix to the forgeable route (tighten upsertTaskOutputSchema, refuse a caller-supplied createdByRunId) would legitimately CLOSE E7-F015 and leave this wide open: E7-F015 needs an authenticated caller acting deliberately, this needs nobody to do anything at all and leaves no trace distinguishable from ordinary operation. HIGH rather than E7-F015's MEDIUM, argued both ways: capabilityProven gates nothing today (--require-capability off by default, verify-e7-1-distributed-run.ts:65; referenced by no workflow or script per E7-F018) and the strong form needs the dial armed, which staging-manifest-invariants.mjs:516-541 forbids on staging - so blast radius TODAY is zero; but the error direction removes the reviewer's question entirely, it fires on the DEFAULT isolated-workspace configuration of exactly the runs the campaign will try first, it fires BEFORE the handoff so it is invariant to whether distributed execution works, and its trigger is the single step E7-F018 says is owed next. HIGH may never be `accepted` and this is not being accepted. NO FIX IS DESIGNED HERE: the finding states the residual any fix must meet - arm 2 must count only rows whose provenance is a distributed agent's OUTPUT, not merely exclude untrusted callers - and deliberately does not guess a predicate. See docs/replatform/epics/E7-coding-e2b/findings.md E7-F020.
